verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents one-command installs: `pip install open-webui`, plus a quick-start Docker command that "pulls the image and starts it." The GitHub README also lists pip, uv, Docker and Kubernetes installs, and the getting-started page promises a first AI conversation in under five minutes. Community notes about very large Docker images point to install friction but do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the under-five-minutes claim, and the exact Docker command text in the evidence.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes

citations.quote: run the command below; it pulls the image and starts it
